candidates.title: Introducing Claude Haiku 5.5 on AWS
candidates.summary: Claude Haiku 5.5 is now available on Amazon Bedrock and Claude Platform on AWS. According to Anthropic, it is the fastest, most efficient model in the Claude 5.5 family, built for subagents and high-volume, cost-sensitive work, and costs around 75% less than Claude Haiku 4.5 for most tasks. This post covers its improvements and how to get started.

candidates.title: Microsoft releases new Nvidia-chip AI PCs with revamped Windows 11
candidates.summary: Microsoft revealed the specs and price for its Surface Laptop Ultra, AI PCs that run on Nvidia chips that are designed to run AI models and agents.

candidates.title: Meta’s Muse launches on iPad just a month after its mobile debut
candidates.summary: Meta’s AI agent Muse is now available on iPad, just a month after its mobile debut, as the company rapidly expands the assistant’s reach and integrations.

candidates.title: Pollo AI turns creative ideas into campaigns with OpenAI
candidates.summary: With GPT-5.6, GPT-6 Astra, and GPT‑Image‑2.5, Pollo AI helps creators turn bold ideas into detailed images and cinematic video ads.

candidates.title: Disrupting AI-enabled “false front” operations
candidates.summary: OpenAI disrupted two AI-enabled influence operations that used false-front journalists and a think tank to spread geopolitical messaging.

candidates.title: Rethinking access control for RAG with Amazon Quick and Amazon Bedrock
candidates.summary: Enterprise RAG unlocks insights from knowledge sources like SharePoint, Google Drive, and Confluence, but those sources carry complex permissions. Learn how Amazon Quick and Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases enforce document-level access controls in real time, verifying permissions directly with authoritative sources at query time.
